description.value: Biblio Taco is a Mexican street food restaurant in the heart of downtown Cumberland, serving handcrafted tacos and burritos made from scratch with locally sourced meats, fish, and fresh produce — even the hot sauces are made in-house. The restaurant was built explicitly for Cumberland's active outdoor community and calls out cyclists directly, noting their food is 'perfect for after a long ride.' West coast ingredients are woven into a Mexican culinary tradition, making this a standout refuelling stop on Vancouver Island's premier mountain biking and touring corridor.
